name: Nosferatu
source: Pathfinder Monster Core 2, Vampire, Nosferatu (pg. 338), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=630
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core 2 is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a living creature of 8th level or higher. Increase its level by 1; AC, attacks, DCs, saves and skills by 1; Strike damage by 1; its Speed by 5 feet or to 30 feet, whichever is higher. Fewer HP, for fast healing and resistance to physical damage (except magical wood) by its level. Becomes an unholy undead vampire: darkvision, void healing, immunities, plagued coffin restoration, nosferatu vulnerabilities, claws carrying plague of ancients, fangs, telekinetic haul, Change Shape, Command Thrall, Dominate and Drink Blood. An overlord (14th level or higher, millennia old) also gains Air of Sickness, vampiric exsanguination and Paralytic Fear.
optional: Damage: only its Strikes deal 1 more; add 1 to its other offensive abilities (2 for limited ones) by hand. It loses abilities that come from being a living creature, and traits of its life other than human, humanoid and the ancestries (removed here): remove those by hand, and adjust abilities that conflict with its theme. Fangs deal moderate to high damage for its level (high here). A claw or fangs Strike it already has isn't replaced: add plague of ancients or Drink Blood to it by hand.

choices.label: Nosferatu overlord
choices.note: A truly primeval nosferatu that has lived for millennia (14th level or higher): Air of Sickness, vampiric exsanguination and Paralytic Fear.

choices.label: Body
choices.note: Claws if it had hands; fangs if it had teeth.

choices.label: Write out the abilities' rules text
choices.note: Monster Core 2 prints the nosferatu's abilities in full, so they always are; this adds Plagued Coffin Restoration's text (otherwise only named in the HP line).

abilities.name: Plagued Coffin Restoration
abilities.description: Unlike other undead, {name} isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, they disperse into an immense number of rats heading in every direction in an attempt to return to their coffin. If even a single rat reaches the coffin, {name} can recover. {Name} regains their strength through resting in earth taken from the grave of a creature that died of plague. If their body rests in their earth-filled coffin for 1 hour, {name} gains 1 HP, after which their fast healing begins to function normally. If the coffin doesn't contain this plagued grave dirt, they instead need to rest in their coffin for 1 day before they gain 1 HP and regain their fast healing.

abilities.name: Air of Sickness
abilities.description: 30 feet. A creature entering or starting its turn in the aura must attempt a DC {spelldc:moderate} Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is sickened 1 and takes a –2 status penalty to saves to resist diseases and remove the sickened condition for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Nosferatu Vulnerabilities
abilities.description:
{Name} has the following vulnerabilities.
**Revulsion** {Name} can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option. To brandish garlic or a religious symbol, a creature must Interact to do so for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If {name} involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the fleeing condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, {name} can attempt a DC 25 Will save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for 1d6 rounds (or 1 hour on a critical success).
**Stake** A magical wooden stake (such as one affected by a weapon potency rune, _runic weapon_, or similar magic) driven through {name}'s heart drops them to 0 HP and prevents them from healing above 0 HP, even in their coffin. Staking a nosferatu requires 3 actions and works only if the nosferatu is unconscious. If the stake is removed, the nosferatu can heal above 0 HP again, and if they're in their coffin, the 1-hour rest period begins once the stake is removed. If the nosferatu's head is severed and anointed with holy water while the stake is in place, the nosferatu is destroyed.
**Sunlight** If exposed to direct sunlight, {name} immediately becomes slowed 1. The slowed value increases by 1 each time they end their turn in sunlight, and the condition ends when they're no longer in sunlight. If they lose all their actions in this way, they're destroyed.

abilities.name: Change Shape
abilities.description: {Name} transforms into a swarm of pale-gray rats. They gain a land Speed of 30 feet and a climb Speed of 10 feet, and they become Large. In this swarm form, {name} can take an action to deal each enemy in the swarm's space 2d10 piercing damage with a DC {spelldc:high} basic Reflex save. A creature that fails its save is also exposed to plague of ancients.

abilities.name: Command Thrall
abilities.description: Requirements One of {name}'s thralls is present and can hear them; Effect {Name} gives a single command to one of their thralls, which the thrall follows to the best of its ability during its next turn.

abilities.name: Dominate
abilities.description: DC {spelldc:high}. {Name} can cast _dominate_ at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to {name}'s Dominate for 24 hours. Fully destroying {name} ends the domination, but merely reducing them to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.

abilities.name: Drink Blood
abilities.description:
Requirements {Name}'s last action was a successful fangs Strike; Effect {Name} sinks their fangs into the targeted creature to drink its blood. This requires an Athletics check against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature becomes drained 1, and {name} regains HP equal to 10\% of their maximum HP ({=hp / 10} HP), gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to {name} but increases the creature's drained condition value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. {Name} can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but they gain no HP from doing so.
The target creature's drained condition value decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful DC 20 Medicine check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Paralytic Fear
abilities.description:
Requirements {Name}'s last action was a successful claw Strike; Effect {Name} drags the target of the Strike close and freezes its mind in terror. The target must attempt a DC {spelldc:moderate} Will save.
Critical Success The target is unaffected.
Success The target is immobilized by fear until the end of {name}'s next turn.
Failure The target is restrained and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its Fortitude DC against {name}'s Drink Blood ability until the end of {name}'s next turn.
Critical Failure As failure, and the target is frightened 2.

abilities.name: Plague of Ancients
abilities.description: Saving Throw DC {spelldc:high} Fortitude; **Onset** 1 day; Stage 1 drained 1 (1 day); Stage 2 drained 2 and enfeebled 2 (1 day); Stage 3 doomed 1, drained 3, and enfeebled 3 (1 day); Stage 4 doomed 2, drained 3, and enfeebled 3 (1 day); Stage 5 unconscious (1 day); Stage 6 death
